description: Batch 0: Complete Application Experience Research, Route & Screen Inventory, UX Inconsistencies & Usability Analysis
steps: Inventory every route, screen, modal, dropdown, and workflow in apps/admin
Inspect existing shared components and cross-application inconsistencies
Analyze client usability and mobile UX constraints
Produce comprehensive research report and screen inventory matrix

description: Batch 1: Design Foundation, Semantic Tokens, Glass/Purple Accents, Shared Components & Mobile-First Shell
steps: Update tailwind.config.ts and globals.css with semantic glass, purple accent, depth and elevation tokens
Enhance shared components: add PageHeader, Tabs, ConfirmationDialog, SearchInput, StatusIndicators to components/ui
Refine Button, Card, Badge, Modal, FormField, and Drawer components
Modernize AdminShell: mobile drawer, breadcrumbs, workspace context, touch targets, and smooth transitions

description: Batch 2: Core Business Workflows Modernization (Command Center, Business Context, Business Presence, Content Management, Onboarding)
steps: Modernize Command Center (admin/page.tsx) with operational welcome, genuine business status, and clear task cards
Streamline Business Context (admin/business-context/page.tsx) with progressive field grouping, confirmation banners, and saved feedback
Refine Business Presence (admin/business-presence/page.tsx) with clear NAP review, hours, and public preview
Enhance Content Management (admin/content/page.tsx) with section navigation, draft vs published indicators, and explicit publishing
Harmonize Onboarding workflow pages with unified progressive disclosure

description: Batch 3: AI & Media Experiences (AI Content Assistance, Image Studio Visual Alignment, Website Images & Explore Our Work)
steps: Modernize AIContentModal with restrained purple/glass accents, before/after copy diff, and draft acceptance
Preserve Image Studio backend contracts while adding glass toolbars, polished canvas framing, and stable sidebars
Modernize Images page (admin/images/page.tsx) with clear Website Slots vs Explore Our Work galleries, category filters, and bulk actions

description: Batch 4: Daily Operations & Communication (Leads, WhatsApp Business Communication, Social Links, AI Connections, Account)
steps: Elevate Customer Leads (admin/leads/page.tsx) with card-first presentation, quick inquiry scanning, phone/WhatsApp triggers, and detail drawers
Redesign WhatsApp & Social connections as simple Business Communication experience with 3-4 purpose-driven templates, preview, direct launch, and profile URLs
Modernize AI Connections (admin/ai-models/page.tsx) with secure credential handling, status indicators, and clear guidance
Polish Account & Settings with clean tabs, workspace info, and security controls

description: Batch 5: Cross-Application Consistency, Accessibility, Motion Safety, and Full Verification Audit
steps: Verify viewports across 320px, 360px, 375px, 390px, 430px, 768px, 1024px, 1280px, 1440px
Verify modal and popup stability with zero layout shift and proper focus trapping
Ensure WCAG 2.2 AA target contrast, keyboard navigation, and prefers-reduced-motion safety
Run full production build, lint checks, and browser verification audit
Produce comprehensive final report and evidence documentation
